operations.title: Only the visible monodromy exponent controls the power spectrum
operations.statement: For an arbitrary finite H-action rho on F_p^r, power correspondences commute with all coefficient fiber sums and basis-level fiber lifts iff gcd(n,p*exp(im rho))=1; invisible factors in ker rho add no obstruction.
operations.scope: Elementary-abelian kernel, arbitrary finite possibly nonfaithful action, algebraic correspondence only.

operations.title: Nonfaithful visible-monodromy exponent test
operations.protocol: Exhaust n=1..30 for C15 acting on F2^2 through C3 and for trivial C3 action on F2; compare image-exponent and full-quotient predictions.
operations.falsifier: Any fiber/index disagrees with image exponent or invisible quotient primes obstruct compatibility.
